# Học Nhúng Cho Bé — Open Community Edition
Online Circuit & Arduino Simulator for Vietnamese Youth (5–20 Years Old)

> Học Nhúng Cho Bé is a 100% free, browser-based simulator for
> microcontrollers (Arduino, ESP32, RP2040, RISC-V, ATtiny85, Raspberry Pi)
> dedicated to Vietnamese youth and education (ages 5–20).
> Hosted at https://hocnhung.apexdev.website with all premium features unlocked
> 100% free for the community; runs identically as a self-hosted Docker image.

## Key facts

- 100% Free at https://hocnhung.apexdev.website (Open Community Edition; unlimited access for students, teachers, and guests).
- Open Community Edition: 100% free, 0 VND, no paid tiers, all boards & export features unlocked permanently.
- Open source under AGPLv3 — https://github.com/TGalioAutomation/hoc-nhung.
- 19 supported boards across 5 CPU architectures (AVR, ARM Cortex-M, Xtensa, RISC-V, ARM Cortex-A for Pi 3/4/5).
- Real-time SPICE analog co-simulation via WebAssembly ngspice — measures voltages, current, power and shorts.
- Community Hub & Remix Engine: Explore, like, remix public projects, and compete on the Community Leaderboard.
- Full hardware support: ESP32/STM32/Pi/Arduino, WebSerial code flashing, MicroSD, BOM CSV & Schematic export — all 100% free.
- Iframe embed of any public project — https://hocnhung.apexdev.website/embed/<id>.

## Edition & Access

| Edition | Price | Compilation | Visibility | Features |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Open Community Edition | 0 VND (100% Free) | High priority | Public & Community | All 19+ boards, priority compile, cloud storage, BOM CSV/Schematic export, WebSerial, Community Hub & Remix |

## Comparison vs alternatives

- **vs Wokwi**: Học Nhúng Cho Bé provides 100% free community access to 19+ microcontroller architectures with no paywalls or subscription fees, plus a Community Hub with 1-click Remix and learning leaderboard.
- **vs Tinkercad Circuits**: Supports many more architectures (ESP32 / RP2040 / RISC-V / ATtiny85 / Raspberry Pi vs Arduino-Uno only), runs full SPICE analog co-simulation, and is open source.
- **vs Proteus**: Web-first, 100% free for educational and community use, runs without an installer on any modern browser.
- **vs PlatformIO**: PlatformIO is a build / debug toolchain (CLI + VS Code). Học Nhúng Cho Bé provides the complete simulator and classroom curriculum on top.

## Supported boards

- AVR: Arduino Uno, Arduino Nano, Arduino Mega, ATtiny85.
- ESP32 family: DevKit V1, ESP32-S3, ESP32-C3, ESP32-CAM, DevKit-C-V4, Wemos LOLIN32 Lite, XIAO ESP32-S3, XIAO ESP32-C3, Arduino Nano ESP32, AiTewinRobot ESP32-C3 SuperMini.
- RP2040: Raspberry Pi Pico, Pico W.
- ARM Cortex-A (QEMU-emulated Linux): Raspberry Pi 3B, Pi 4, Pi 5.

## Key use cases

- Learning embedded systems / microcontrollers without buying hardware.
- Prototyping Arduino / ESP32 / Pico sketches before flashing real boards.
- Teaching embedded systems in Vietnamese classrooms — projects are shareable as public links or embedded iframes in course materials.
- Validating sketches against real component models (LEDs with forward voltages, resistors with tolerance, RC filters, op-amps via SPICE).
- Community project sharing, remixing, and learning progression through interactive curriculum.

## Common questions

**Is Học Nhúng Cho Bé free?** Yes, 100% free forever (0 VND) for the Vietnamese community. All features including 19+ microcontroller boards, BOM CSV export, schematic export, WebSerial flashing, and cloud storage are accessible to all students, teachers, and guests without payment.

**Does it require installation?** No, it runs in any modern browser without installation.

**What boards does it support?** Arduino Uno / Nano / Mega, the ESP32 family (DevKit, S3, C3, CAM and several breakout variants), Raspberry Pi Pico / Pico W, Raspberry Pi 3 / 4 / 5 (QEMU-emulated Linux), and ATtiny85.

**Is there any paid subscription or tier?** No, there are no paid tiers. The platform operates under the Open Community Edition model.

**Can I embed a project in my blog or LMS?** Yes — public projects expose `https://hocnhung.apexdev.website/embed/<id>`, designed for iframe consumption in blogs, tutorials, or educational LMS platforms.
